{{Quote|If Dooku restores the Dark Reaper, it will mean the end of the Republic.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Game" />}}
The '''Dark Reaper crisis''' was a series of battles at the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|This battle may have turned the tide of the war.''"<br />"''Won the battle we have, but far from over, this war is.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="Game" />}}
As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] were firing up, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] seemed to be at a deadlock. However, in a surprising move, the Separatists attacked the remote [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]]. As the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] soon discovered, it was the first step in a Confederacy plot to assemble the [[Dark Reaper]], an ancient [[Brotherhood of the Sith|Sith]] weapon of mass annihilation that absorbed its power from the life energies of the beings it [[Death/Legends|killed]]. In an attempt to foil [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] scheme, [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] led their forces on the scattered battlefronts of Rhen Var, [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], and [[Thule/Legends|Thule]]. They succeeded, but, as [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] pointed out, the war was far from over.
